description: This file implements an input box dialog in a text-based UI, utilizing the ncurses library for rendering and handling user input. It contains functions for drawing buttons, managing user interaction, and displaying a modal dialog for string input.

methods.name: void print_buttons(WINDOW * dialog,int height,int width,int selected)
methods.description: Helper function to render 'Ok' and 'Help' buttons with selection highlighting.

methods.name: int dialog_inputbox(const char * title,const char * prompt,int height,int width,const char * init)
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog box for string input with title and prompt; manages user interaction and returns the input string or a button code.

ctags.name: dialog_inputbox
ctags.pattern: /^int dialog_inputbox(const char *title, const char *prompt, int height, int width,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * title,const char * prompt,int height,int width,const char * init)

ctags.name: print_buttons
ctags.pattern: /^static void print_buttons(WINDOW * dialog, int height, int width, int selected)$/
